Question: Let \(P(z)=z^8+(4\sqrt{3}+6)z^4\) \(-(4\sqrt{3}+7).\) What is the minimum perimeter among all the \(8\)-sided polygons in the complex plane whose vertices are precisely the zeros of \(P(z)?\)
